q: 商店里___很多人。
en: There are a lot of people in the shop.

q: 超市门口___三辆自行车。
en: There are three bicycles at the supermarket entrance.

q: 公园附近___体育馆，只有一个很小的游泳池。
en: There is no gym near the park, only a very small swimming pool.

q: 那家新开的鞋店里___各种各样的运动鞋，价格也不贵。
en: The newly opened shoe shop has all kinds of sports shoes, and the prices are not high either.

q: 我家附近的体育馆里___一个游泳池和两个羽毛球场。
en: The gym near my home has a swimming pool and two badminton courts.

q: 我的球鞋___门后面。
en: My sports shoes are behind the door.

q: 收银台___商店的左边。
en: The checkout counter is on the left side of the shop.

q: 你要买的那双鞋___三楼。
en: The pair of shoes you want to buy is on the third floor.

q: 小王的羽毛球拍___哪儿？
en: Where is Xiao Wang's badminton racket?

q: 我昨天看中的那件运动服___二楼的女装区旁边。
en: The sports jacket I liked yesterday is next to the women's clothing section on the second floor.

q: 篮球场对面___李老师的家。
en: Across from the basketball court is Teacher Li's home.

q: 我家后面___一个很大的体育馆。
en: Behind my home is a very big gym.

q: 这条街的左边全___卖运动用品的商店，右边都是饭馆。
en: The left side of this street is all shops selling sports goods, and the right side is all restaurants.

q: 手机在桌子___。
en: The phone is on the table.

q: 钱在包___。
en: The money is in the bag.

q: 饮料在冰箱___。
en: The drinks are in the fridge.

q: 他在上海___买了一件运动服。
en: He bought a sports jacket in Shanghai.

q: 我哥哥在北京___学打网球。
en: My older brother is learning to play tennis in Beijing.

q: 价格写在这张小纸___。
en: The price is written on this small piece of paper.

q: 球票放在我的书包___。
en: The match ticket is in my school bag.

q: 教练把比赛名单写在黑板___。
en: The coach wrote the match list on the blackboard.

q: 我把新买的球拍挂在墙___，这样孩子拿不到。
en: I hung the newly bought racket on the wall so the children cannot reach it.

q: 我小时候在广州___学会了游泳，后来才搬到上海。
en: I learned to swim in Guangzhou as a child and only later moved to Shanghai.

q: 咖啡店在体育馆___。
en: The coffee shop is next to the gym.

q: 我的自行车停在商店___，不在里面。
en: My bike is parked outside the shop, not inside it.

q: 这家鞋店在银行和超市___。
en: This shoe shop is between the bank and the supermarket.

q: 游泳池在公园___，走路五分钟就到。
en: The swimming pool is near the park, five minutes on foot.

q: 教练站在我们___。
en: The coach is standing in front of us.

q: 超市___有一家很大的运动用品店。
en: Across from the supermarket there is a big sports goods shop.

q: 球场门口一直站___几个小朋友。
en: A few children have been standing at the entrance of the pitch all along.

q: 我们教室的墙上挂___一张很大的球赛海报。
en: On the wall of our classroom hangs a big match poster.

q: 货架上摆___很多新到的球鞋。
en: Many newly arrived sports shoes are displayed on the shelves.

q: 柜台上放___三瓶饮料。
en: There are three bottles of drink on the counter.

q: 昨天我们队来___一个新教练。
en: A new coach joined our team yesterday.

q: 对面新开___一家体育用品店。
en: A new sports goods shop has opened across the street.

q: 我们公司走___三个人，现在只剩五个人。
en: Three people have left our company; now only five remain.

q: 商店门口突然出现___一大群人，大家都在等打折。
en: A big crowd suddenly appeared at the shop entrance; everyone was waiting for the sale.

q: 冰箱里___饮料了。
en: There are no more drinks in the fridge.

q: 老板今天___店里。
en: The boss is not in the shop today.

q: 我的球拍___桌子上，你再找找。
